gameDescriptionHtml:
771: Smile and Work is a first-person indie horror game in the walking simulator genre.

Estimated playtime: 40 minutes

  • Horror game
  • Walking simulator
  • First-person perspective
  • High-quality sound
  • Realistic graphics

ABOUT THE TEAM
This project is the result of the work of seven developers. Each developer worked on the project for exactly one day, without knowing what the others had created until their turn came. 7 developers. 7 days. 1 game!

We took the lessons learned from the first game in this series and continue to develop the concept, experimenting with a unique approach to game development.

DESCRIPTION
You wake up in the middle of the night and suddenly get called in to work. At first, nothing seems out of the ordinary. Just a regular office. Just another night shift. The important thing is to keep working. And don’t forget to smile.

GAMEPLAY
Have you ever worked a night shift? Will it make you smile? You will find yourself in an office that looks completely different at night. Complete your boss’s tasks and stay alert. Sometimes, there is something far more disturbing hiding behind ordinary work duties.
